prediction.why: New York Islanders is the pick — Elite goaltending and a stingy defense make them a real Cup-shaped team; their offense and underlying play are merely middling, so they must keep stopping pucks.

read.why: Drives play AND gets saves — underlying numbers (#9 Corsi) and goaltending (#2) both hold up, which is the rare combination that survives four rounds. The genuine Cup shape.
